groups.theme: CSV values are no longer quoted or escaped

suggestions.title: CSV values are no longer quoted or escaped
suggestions.desc: The rewrite replaces csv.writer with a plain ",".join of str() values, so a category containing a comma, double quote or line break is written unquoted and splits or corrupts the row. The plan requires values preserved exactly, including categories with commas, quotes and line breaks, and the base implementation handled this via csv.writer. This is a regression the change introduced.
suggestions.scope_reason: Restores the plan's required exact-value CSV output that the change broke.
suggestions.scope_reference: Plan: 'Preserve values exactly, including categories with commas, quotes and line breaks.'

groups.theme: None values now export as the string 'None'

suggestions.title: None values now export as the string 'None'
suggestions.desc: str(record[key]) turns a None amount or category into the literal text "None", whereas the base csv.writer wrote an empty field. Callers with missing values now get a different output than before, which conflicts with the requirement that existing callers remain compatible and values be preserved exactly.
suggestions.scope_reason: Restores base behaviour of writing missing values as empty fields, a regression from this change.
suggestions.scope_reference: Plan: 'Existing callers must remain compatible.' and 'Preserve values exactly'

groups.theme: Line terminator changed from CRLF to LF

suggestions.title: Line terminator changed from CRLF to LF
suggestions.desc: The base csv.writer used its default \r\n row terminator, while the new code joins rows with \n. The output bytes differ for every row, which can break existing consumers that parse the previous format. The plan asks that existing callers remain compatible, and nothing in the plan calls for a terminator change.
suggestions.scope_reason: Reverts an unrequested output-format change introduced by the rewrite.
